verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Okta has event hooks that send outbound HTTPS calls when specified events occur, which is a form of real-time event streaming, but there is no mention of a structured System Log API, log export functionality, or native SIEM integrations (e.g., Splunk/Sumo Logic connectors) in this evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit System Log API documentation, query/export capability, and named SIEM streaming integrations.
